title: wildmat: update GroupsConfig validation to accept patterns
description:
## Why
Needed by stoa-efbe068a. The current `validate_group_name` rejects `*`, `?`, and `!` — all valid wildmat characters. Config parsing must accept patterns, not just strict RFC 3977 group names.

## What
- Replace `validate_group_name` call on `[groups] names` entries with `validate_wildmat_pattern`
- `validate_wildmat_pattern`: allow `*`, `?`, `!` prefix in addition to existing charset
- Reject config where all patterns are negations (no positive pattern — would accept nothing)
- Update config tests
